{{Top|leg}}
The '''Red Hulls''' was a gang that was active in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during the [[Galactic War]]; they were infamous for being [[Cannibalism|cannibals]]. The [[Corellian Run Scoundrels]] owed the Red Hulls a large debt.

==Behind the scenes==
Republic players in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' will be mistaken for the captain of the Red Hulls, while Imperial players will be mistaken for the leader of the [[Howling Tempest Gang]].
